1.explanation:
To understand and reproduce the hang at “Loading page & waiting for onload,” you need to trace through how Lighthouse drives Chrome, waits for the page’s load event, and then runs the PWA gatherers (ServiceWorker, Offline, StartUrl). 

• gather/driver-test.js and gather/fake-driver.js show how the driver navigates and listens for onload
• gather/gather-runner-test.js orchestrates page navigation and gatherer execution
gather/gatherers/service-worker-test.js, offline-test.js, and start-url-test.js cover the individual steps that run once the page is loaded. Together, these files let you replicate the navigation → wait-for-onload → gather pipeline and pinpoint where it fails to resolve the load event, causing the indefinite hang.
1.bug_scenario: When a Progressive Web App–only audit is launched (either via the native Chrome audit panel or the Lighthouse extension), Lighthouse navigates to the target URL and then stalls indefinitely at the “Loading page & waiting for onload” step. The chrome-style dialog shows the Lighthouse lighthouse-style illustration with the caption “ServiceWorker, Offline, StartUrl,” and a cancel button. This indicates that the gather-runner has started the SW/offline/start-URL gatherers but never receives the page’s load event, causing the audit to hang forever.
